notes.legend: Warriors from around the land gather for a competition of might in Coatlan, with fame, fortune and favour on offer to the victor.

notes.legend: A fair is being held in Halam, with all manner of local and foreign goods and services on offer.

notes.legend: A jubilee has been organised at Eagrones as a chance to gather the suspected revolutionaries of the area together to be merry, make alliances and scheme around the crisis.

notes.legend: This entrancing mirage has been luring travellers out of their way for eons.

notes.legend: The Coapancopotom Chasm. Locals claim that it is the home of strange monsters.

notes.name: Charecie Necropolis
notes.legend: A foreboding necropolis perched atop a jagged cliff, overlooking a desolate wasteland. Its towering walls harbor restless spirits, and the imposing gates bear the marks of countless battles and ancient curses.

notes.name: Ronemongulf Crypt
notes.legend: This ethereal necropolis seems suspended between the realms of the living and the dead. Wisps of mist dance around the tombstones, while haunting melodies linger in the air, commemorating the departed.

notes.name: Nippa-Sha Necropolis
notes.legend: Rising from the desolate landscape, this sinister necropolis is a testament to necromantic power. Its skeletal spires cast ominous shadows, concealing forbidden knowledge and arcane secrets.
